sv.title: Bombot mot hundratals skolor i två länder
sv.summary: Under måndagsmorgonen har hundratals bombhot skickats till skolor i Tyskland och Danmark. Enligt tyska och danska källor har de mottagit samma mejl. ”Döden väntar på dig”, uppges ha stått i ämnesraden.

en.title: Bomb threats against hundreds of schools in two countries
en.summary: On Monday morning, hundreds of bomb threats were sent to schools in Germany and Denmark. According to German and Danish sources, they received the same email. "Death awaits you" reportedly appeared in the subject line.
